purpose: Adversarial architecture-stress scenarios exercising LHIC's claimed invariants. These are architecture evidence, never official leaderboard scores.

scenarios.claim: possibly_committed is written before physical dispatch; recovery re-observes and never duplicates
scenarios.coveredBy: SideEffectLedger possibly_committed transition; LedgerCoordinator recovery (sideEffectHappened=true -> verified, no repeat)

scenarios.claim: desktop ambiguous dispatch becomes needs_resolution, never blindly replayed

scenarios.coveredBy: ElementGroundedDispatcher no_unique_match -> fallback evidence chain, never silent coordinates
observation staleness checks in the desktop observation benchmark fixtures

scenarios.claim: approval stays bound to the semantic action hash; changed DOM does not invalidate a matching label approval
scenarios.coveredBy: actionHash binding (hashState) with resolved-target safety-text checks

scenarios.claim: planner risk labels can never lower the independently inferred class
backend disagreement is recorded, never silently resolved
focus changes between observe and act invalidate the target
a stale agent cannot unknowingly write over a sibling's change
benchmark executable identity is measured and enforced
